title: apricity export --sidecars in apricity-cli: flags, help, report, errors
description:
## Intent
The command.

## Scope
- `crates/apricity-cli/src/export.rs` + `Cmd::Export` in `main.rs`: `apricity export --sidecars <PATH>... [--library DIR] [--dry-run] [--force]`. If apricitus-6edba8 already added `export`, add `--sidecars` as a mode beside `--daw-set` (exactly one mode per run, else "choose one of --daw-set, --sidecars").
- Walks folders for audio with a manifest (the same audio extensions as analysis), reads manifests with `apricity_score::Clip::load`, calls `plan_sample_sidecar`, writes atomically (temp file + rename).
- `--help` text: one line per flag, and an example.
- Report: one line per sample, then a summary ("3 sidecars written, 1 unchanged, 1 skipped"); non-zero exit if anything was refused.
- Errors: `path: reason` (no such file, not audio, stale analysis).

## Verify
`safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-cli --test daw_cli` (file-mode scenarios green) and `./target/debug/apricity export --help`.

Commit: `feat(<this id>): apricity export --sidecars`.

---
**Toolchain:** every Bash call starts with `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2`; run builds and tests under the watchdog: `safe-run.sh -- <command>` (6 GB / 20 min cap; do not edit it). At most two Rust-building agents at once.
**Protocol:** specs first (write the scenario, watch it fail, then code); keep a running log with `kbs comment` (decisions, problems, attempts, outcomes); paste the tail of **Verify** before asking for review; never commit, push or close (the reviewer does, after re-running Verify). Never write the DAW's brand name anywhere.
